item.title: Jersey Dairy responds to questions over milk shelf life

item.title: Landmark assisted-dying law passes final hurdle
item.description: LANDMARK legislation to introduce a legal right for Islanders with terminal conditions to end their lives passed the final hurdle in the States Assembly this morning.
